# Aontu

> Aontu is a JSON-superset unification language and validation gate for
> AI-agent ground truth. One document can carry data, the schema that
> constrains it, and the defaults that fill it in; a single operation —
> unification — combines them or reports exactly where they conflict,
> with two-sited findings and stable error codes. The toolchain's verbs
> serve the agent loop: `vet` validates data against a schema, `get` and
> `why` query a document and explain a value's provenance, `subsume` and
> `breaking` gate schema evolution, `hash` pins what a document means,
> `set` repairs a value in place, `relations` checks declared entity
> graphs, `reaches` answers whether one entity reaches another at any
> remove, `jsonschema` exports the model as JSON Schema and reports
> what that export cannot carry, and an MCP server exposes the same
> contracts over stdio. Two
> implementations (TypeScript, canonical, npm `aontu`; a Go port) are
> kept in parity by one shared conformance suite, under a written trust
> contract (hermeticity, termination, determinism, sandboxing).

## Docs

- [Documentation home](docs/index.md): the map of the documentation and
  a 30-second taste of the language
- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): learn Aontu from zero — unification,
  types, exact numbers, defaults, references, templates, vet
- [Language reference](docs/reference-language.md): every construct and
  rule — the exhaustive, dry source of truth for the language
- [API reference](docs/reference-api.md): the CLI verbs with flags and
  exit codes, the TypeScript and Go APIs, and the MCP server
- [Trust contract](docs/trust.md): the guarantees a host may rely on
  when evaluating a document, and exactly where each is conditional

## Agent-facing

- [Aontu skill](docs/skill/SKILL.md): a teaching pack for agents — the
  grammar card, a worked example ladder, and the error-code index
- [Grammars](grammar/): `aontu.gbnf` and `aontu.lark`, the emission
  surface for constrained decoding of canonical Aontu

## Conformance and review

- [Shared spec suite](test/spec/): the conformance corpus — 3k+
  language-agnostic cases both implementations must satisfy; a third
  implementation claims conformance by passing it
- [Executable review](use-cases/): sixteen enterprise use cases driven
  through the real CLI, with verified findings and minimal repros

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the contributor and agent guide — layout,
  build/test, the shared-spec workflow, and the parity probe
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): the security policy — confinement
  escapes, budget bypasses and hermeticity breaks are in scope
